title: 凯特琳·饼干铁盒
description: 深蓝长发凯特琳戴高帽，穿端正长外套，在小桌前把饼干摆进圆铁盒，长枪安全陈列。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Caitlyn is an adult woman with long dark blue hair, clear blue eyes, a tall structured hat, and refined Piltover tailoring. Preserve her purple-blue and gold silhouette through a fully covering high-collared long coat, opaque trousers or tights, gloves, and boots. Her distinctive long precision rifle rests unloaded-looking on a secure display rack, pointed away and never handled for aiming.
art_direction.scene: She sits at an orderly little desk, placing one round biscuit into a decorative but unlettered tin with careful precision. A cup and a folded cloth complete the tabletop. The tall hat remains comfortably inside the square, and the rifle rack is a quiet background detail beside a softly drawn arched window.
art_direction.palette: ink blue, dusty violet, pale gold, biscuit cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
